caption:
5 places India forgot 🗺️

A railway washed away in 1924, a town the sea swallowed overnight, Stone Age art in Wayanad, a lake full of skeletons, and a village of twins. Which one did you know? 👇

Save this for later, and share this with someone who loves mysteries. 📩
